Procedural Wood Material

`/home/user/Desktop/scene.blend` contains a 2x2 BU UV-unwrapped plane named `Board` at the origin. It has a grey Principled BSDF material `WoodMat` containing an Image Texture node referencing a blank 512x512 RGBA image datablock named `WoodBake`. The `WoodBake` image texture node is the active node on the material.

Your task: rebuild `WoodMat`'s node tree into a procedural wood shader (NO external texture file — purely from shader nodes like Texture Coordinate, Noise, Wave, Vector Math, and Color Ramp), bake the diffuse color onto the `WoodBake` image, and save the result to `/home/user/Desktop/wood.png` at 512x512.

Bake the diffuse color of the procedural wood material into `WoodBake`, then save the baked image to `/home/user/Desktop/wood.png`.

## Requirements
1. `/home/user/Desktop/wood.png` exists.
2. Image is exactly 512x512.
3. Brown hue: mean R > mean G > mean B AND mean R in [0.2, 0.7].
4. Banding detected: along the central row of the image, counting sign-crossings of (pixel luma - row mean luma), at least 4 zero-crossings (distinct bright/dark alternations).
5. Color variation: per-pixel luma standard deviation >= 0.05.
6. Dark and light present: min luma < 0.15 AND max luma > 0.40.
